name: K Largest Elements
description: Finds the k largest elements in an array using a min-heap of size k. The heap always holds the k largest seen so far.
aim: Find k largest elements in O(n log k) time by maintaining a min-heap of size k: replace minimum if new element is larger.
howItWorks: Insert first k elements into min-heap
For each remaining element: if element > heap minimum, replace minimum and heapify
After processing all elements, heap contains k largest

time.bestCase: Process all n elements with O(log k) heap operations
time.averageCase: Better than O(n log n) when k << n

whenToUse: Streaming data where you can't store all elements
alternatives: Quick Select — O(n) average but not for streaming
Full sort + take k — O(n log n) simpler but slower

inputHint: The LAST number is k; the array is everything before it.
